title: sequences.json contract
description: Structural contract for <module>/Verification/simulation-plan/sequences.json — the sequence roster, the one part of the plan both consumers read: simulation compiles a <module>_<name>_seq class per entry, and power-analysis resolves power-scenarios.json's sequence_ref against these names.

agent.description: The agents[].name this sequence drives. Required: power-analysis's emit_power_tests builds the env member m_<agent>_agent from it and hard-fails on an entry that omits it, so an optional one would pass this stage's gate and break two stages downstream.

desc.description: One line on what the sequence drives, rendered into the generated seq class's header comment by simulation's scaffold renderer.
